          "viewState": {

            "pitch": 55.17280350846221,

    {
      "id": "/video-spheres",
      "type": "CodeOp",
      "position": {
        "x": -400,
        "y": 60

      "width": 900,
      "height": 680,
      "measured": {
        "width": 900,
        "height": 680
      },
      "data": {
        "inputs": {
          "code": [
            "// Generate a UV sphere as a loaders.gl Mesh object (deck.gl accepts this natively)",
            "function generateSphere(radius, nlat, nlong) {",
            "  const positions = [], normals = [], texCoords = [], indices = []",
            "  for (let lat = 0; lat <= nlat; lat++) {",
            "    const theta = (lat * Math.PI) / nlat",
            "    const sinTheta = Math.sin(theta), cosTheta = Math.cos(theta)",
            "    for (let lon = 0; lon <= nlong; lon++) {",
            "      const phi = (lon * 2 * Math.PI) / nlong",
            "      const x = Math.cos(phi) * sinTheta, y = cosTheta, z = Math.sin(phi) * sinTheta",
            "      positions.push(x * radius, y * radius, z * radius)",
            "      normals.push(x, y, z)",
            "      texCoords.push(lon / nlong, lat / nlat)",
            "    }",
            "  }",
            "  for (let lat = 0; lat < nlat; lat++) {",
            "    for (let lon = 0; lon < nlong; lon++) {",
            "      const a = lat * (nlong + 1) + lon, b = a + nlong + 1",
            "      indices.push(a, b, a + 1, b, b + 1, a + 1)",
            "    }",
            "  }",
            "  return {",
            "    topology: 'triangle-list',",
            "    attributes: {",
            "      POSITION: { size: 3, value: new Float32Array(positions) },",
            "      NORMAL: { size: 3, value: new Float32Array(normals) },",
            "      TEXCOORD_0: { size: 2, value: new Float32Array(texCoords) },",
            "    },",
            "    indices: { size: 1, value: new Uint32Array(indices) },",
            "  }",
            "}",
            "const sphere = generateSphere(1, 40, 40)",
            "",
            "const makeVideo = (v) => {",
            "  if (v.isImage) return v.url",
            "  const el = document.createElement('video')",
            "  el.src = v.url + (v.startTime ? `#t=${v.startTime}` : '')",
            "  el.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'",
            "  el.loop = true",
            "  el.muted = true",
            "  el.autoplay = true",
            "  el.play().catch((e) => console.warn('[cesium-hubble] autoplay blocked:', e))",
            "  return el",
            "}",
            "",
            "const videos = [",
            "  { url: 'https://pointcloud-videos.s3.amazonaws.com/yt5s.com-Amazing%20Street%20Musicians%20Performing%20in%20New%20York%20City%2C%20Street%20Performers-%281080p%29.mp4', position: [-74.0152298040547, 40.70303169832896], radius: 150 },",
            "  { url: 'https://pointcloud-videos.s3.amazonaws.com/yt5s.com-Amazingly%20talented%20child%20subway%20drummer-%281080p%29.mp4', position: [-73.99666928636229, 40.72193350352984], radius: 100 },",
            "  { url: 'https://pointcloud-videos.s3.amazonaws.com/yt5s.com-Musicians%20outside%20of%20Cooper%20Union%20%28NYC%29-%28480p%29.mp4', position: [-73.986876427207, 40.73186576289673], radius: 100 },",
            "  { url: 'https://pointcloud-videos.s3.amazonaws.com/X2Download.com-the%20coolest%20saxophone%20subway%20band%20ever.mp4', position: [-73.99583300957174, 40.745258134105356], radius: 100, startTime: 5 },",
            "  { url: 'https://pointcloud-videos.s3.amazonaws.com/Woman%20Randomly%20Walks%20Off%20the%20Street%20to%20Join%20Street%20Musicians%20%5BTSNfJ7ibvCo%5D.webm', position: [-73.97545461759636, 40.753129712361265], radius: 100 },",
            "  { url: 'https://pointcloud-videos.s3.amazonaws.com/Coyote%20%26%20Crow%20perform%20live%20at%20Union%20Square%20%5Bf8KZqLy1Pb0%5D.webm', position: [-73.98910522225347, 40.741538412081425], radius: 100 },",
            "  { url: 'https://pointcloud-videos.s3.amazonaws.com/X2Download.com-This%20is%20amazing%21%20A%20spontaneous%20piano_sax%20performance%20with%20Ladyva%20at%20Charles%20de%20Gaulle%20airport.mp4', position: [-74.00787624379548, 40.71512284456615], radius: 100 },",
            "  { url: 'https://pointcloud-videos.s3.amazonaws.com/X2Download.com-Drum%20Circle.%20Prospect%20Park.%20Brooklyn.%20July%2019%202015..mp4', position: [-73.97181924048971, 40.76951659152664], radius: 100 },",
            "  { url: 'https://pointcloud-videos.s3.amazonaws.com/X2Download.com-Best%20Drummer%20Ever%20%5BHD%5D.mp4', position: [-73.98993325227518, 40.75865902126557], radius: 100 },",
            "  { url: 'https://pointcloud-videos.s3.amazonaws.com/Rosatera%20singing%20in%20the%20New%20York%20City%20Subway%20%5B9kY8mpeT5wo%5D.webm', position: [-73.98764377704777, 40.749780590644505], radius: 100 },",
            "  { url: 'https://pointcloud-videos.s3.amazonaws.com/Awesome%20Street%20Jazz%20Band%20In%20Central%20Park%20%5B_yu_6kOSWR8%5D.webm', position: [-73.9691642676795, 40.773157848397055], radius: 100 },",
            "  { url: 'https://pointcloud-videos.s3.amazonaws.com/C0010T01.JPG', position: [-73.99204731640815, 40.70971999194366], radius: 150, orientation: [0, 0, -90], isImage: true },",
            "]",
            "",
            "return videos.map((v, i) => ({",
            "  type: 'SimpleMeshLayer',",
            "  id: `video-sphere-${i}`,",
            "  data: [0],",
            "  mesh: sphere,",
            "  texture: makeVideo(v),",
            "  getOrientation: v.orientation ?? [0, 90, -90],",
            "  getPosition: [v.position[0], v.position[1], 0],",
            "  sizeScale: v.radius,",
            "  material: false,",
            "}))"
          ]
        },
        "locked": false
      }
